codeReview.summary: The new /api/register endpoint correctly enforces JWT auth and required-body validation (covers VAL-REG-001 and VAL-REG-002), but the voice-agent integration is not fully functional and misses required data-channel result handling in key paths.

issues.description: register_event depends on a JWT from user_tokens[room_name] and exits early when missing, but the frontend never sends the required `auth_token` data-channel message (frontend/src/app/page.tsx only publishes `{type: "email"}` at line 188). In the shipped flow, register_event cannot reliably call POST /api/register, so the expected behavior "Voice agent register_event tool calls /api/register endpoint" is not met.

For backend HTTP responses 401/400/non-200 (lines 107, 113, 119), the function returns immediately without publishing a terminal registration result to the frontend data channel. This violates the feature requirement that the voice agent send registration results to the frontend and can leave UI state without a final failed status.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Data-channel contract mismatch: mission AGENTS.md defines registration_progress payload key as `event_id`, but implementation sends `event_url`.
A new inbound `auth_token` message type was introduced in voice_agent but is not reflected in shared protocol docs and not emitted by the current frontend implementation.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: agent/voice_agent.py:251 reads `msg.get("type") == "auth_token"`; frontend/src/app/page.tsx:188 only publishes `{ type: "email", email }`; architecture/docs list message types without `auth_token`.

summary: Review result: FAIL. /api/register endpoint behavior for auth and required-field validation is implemented, but voice-agent integration has blocking gaps: missing token wiring in the real frontend flow and missing terminal data-channel result messages for several failure responses.
